verses.english: “Mendicants, this transmigration has no known beginning. …

verses.pali: na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo napitābhūtapubbo …pe…
verses.english: It’s not easy to find a sentient being who in all this long time has not previously been your father. …
This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”
